name: Min-jun K.
comment: The fit is exactly what I wanted: relaxed without feeling oversized in the wrong way. The sleeve artwork looks even better in person.

name: Aarav S.
comment: Really soft, substantial cotton and a great shape. I have already worn it with both cargos and denim.

name: Hana T.
comment: Love the pattern and the careful details. I sized down for a less roomy look and it worked perfectly.

name: Riya M.
comment: The print feels unique without being hard to style. The fabric has a nice weight to it.

name: Daniel W.
comment: Great relaxed fit and the detailing is sharp. It has quickly become one of my regular weekend tees.
